hooks.text: In 1915, pack ice crushed the expedition ship Endurance.
How did 28 men survive on the world's deadliest ocean?
Four sun sightings saved 28 men from the Antarctic ice.

title: How Did Shackleton's Crew Survive the Deadliest Ocean? ⚓
description: In 1916, Sir Ernest Shackleton launched a desperate 800-mile rescue mission in a tiny 22-foot lifeboat. This is the incredible story of survival and the James Caird.
